name: end_call
description: Ends the call gracefully after a confirmed outcome. Use it only when the conversation is truly finished: every query answered and every outcome settled (booking confirmed and the goodbye done, callback wrap-up complete, or the prospect clearly said goodbye). Always confirm next steps, ask if anything else is needed, say goodbye warmly, then end. NEVER use it mid-conversation to escape confusion, an objection, a failed tool call, or an unbooked prospect — every stage has a fallback; follow it instead.
